title: Blueberry Syrup for Pancakes
excerpt: Learn to make a delicious homemade blueberry syrup, ideal for topping your pancakes, waffles or toast with all the sweetness and aroma of fresh fruit.
imageAlt: Blueberry syrup pouring gently over a stack of golden, fluffy pancakes
steps: In a small pot over medium heat, combine the water, honey and lemon juice until the honey dissolves completely.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries to the pot and stir well to combine them with the liquid.

Cook over medium-low heat for 10 to 12 minutes, letting the mixture simmer gently. You will notice that the high-mountain blueberries grown in Guasca gradually release their natural juice and take on a soft texture.
With the help of a wooden spoon, gently press some blueberries against the side of the pot to release more flavor, leaving others whole for a delicious texture.
Remove the pot from the heat, add the vanilla and the pinch of cinnamon, and stir gently.
Let the syrup rest for 5 minutes at room temperature so it thickens a little before serving it warm over your pancakes.
tips: Store leftover syrup in a tightly closed glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. To use it again, just warm it for a few seconds.
If you prefer a completely smooth texture without pieces of fruit, pass the hot syrup through a fine strainer before letting it rest.
